name: Wonder and Method
founderBio: I’m Terry, the person behind Wonder and Method. I’ve been working on websites and technology since 2018 and have started several small businesses along the way. That experience shapes how I approach a site: make it clear, useful, and manageable for the person running the business. From my studio in Buffalo, I work directly with you on the content, design and details that help customers understand what you offer. You know who is doing the work and who to contact when you have a question.
responseWindow: Terry replies within one business day, Monday–Friday, Eastern Time. Messages received on weekends are reviewed on the next business day.

privacy.purpose: We use your inquiry to understand the project, decide whether our services fit, and respond to you. Submitting an inquiry does not book a project or subscribe you to marketing. Please provide business details needed for the discussion and avoid passwords, payment information or sensitive personal information.
privacy.access: The owner of Venture House Group LLC personally reviews inquiries. Access is limited to the owner and the services needed to host the site, store inquiries, deliver email, operate optional chat and process agreed payments. We do not sell inquiry information or share it for targeted advertising. Our providers may also process information for their own security, compliance and service-operation purposes under their policies.
privacy.networkData: Our hosting provider processes connection and request information, including IP addresses, to deliver and protect the site. Our inquiry application uses keyed identifiers derived from the network address for short-lived rate controls. To avoid saving an accidental repeat, it compares normalized submitted fields with saved inquiries in the same processing mode from the preceding ten minutes. Each saved inquiry also has a keyed internal marker derived from a random reference. The application does not store the raw network address in the inquiry record. The rate-control records expire after 20 minutes and are removed by an hourly cleanup job; provider network records and recovery copies can last longer.
privacy.retention: For inquiries that do not become client projects, we delete our working inquiry and chat records and matching owner-controlled email and export copies within 90 days after the last substantive project contact, or after submission if there is no response. Routine internal review and automated reminders do not restart that period. If a project proceeds, the necessary records follow the separately reviewed client and accounting schedule. We may preserve specific records for a documented dispute or legal obligation, with the reason and a review date recorded.
privacy.providerRetention: Deletion from our working records does not immediately erase every recovery or provider copy. Under the selected Free services, Cloudflare documents a seven-day D1 recovery window and three-day Workers log retention; Resend documents 30-day email and log retention. Fastmail describes a 7–14 day recovery period for deleted email and does not give a fixed pruning schedule for all backup and index copies. Inquiry notifications and email correspondence are stored in Gmail: Trash can retain messages for 30 days, and Google describes encrypted backups lasting up to six months, with possible delays and exceptions. These periods describe different systems, not a promise that every copy disappears on the same date. See the linked provider policies for their processing and retention details. tawk.to keeps chat records until they are deleted and describes backup retention of up to 90 days, with possible mandatory retention exceptions. Our 90-day unsuccessful-inquiry cleanup is an owner-managed process, not an automatic provider purge.
privacy.rights: Email support@wonderandmethod.com for questions or to request access, correction or deletion of your inquiry. Include the inquiry reference if you have it; do not send identity documents or passwords in the first message. We may ask for proportionate confirmation that the inquiry is yours. We assess requests under the law that applies and explain any information we need to retain and why.
privacy.locations: The selected services may process information in the United States and other countries where they operate. The inquiry system is not represented as New York-only storage. Provider policies describe their international processing arrangements.
privacy.changes: We will update this notice when our inquiry practices change and show the review date. New analytics, marketing tools or materially different uses require a fresh review before they are enabled.

privacy.chat: Chat is optional and provided by tawk.to. Its code loads only after you select “Message us.” Selecting “Message us” loads the chat provider and may allow its cookies and local storage. You can use the form or email without loading chat. When you use chat, tawk.to receives your messages, any name or email you provide, the page address, and connection and device information such as IP address and browser details. The studio owner can read and answer through the dashboard or mobile app. A returning-visitor cookie may last six months; other chat storage can last for the session. Please avoid passwords, payment details and sensitive personal information. You can use email or the contact form instead. We do not use AI chat agents.
privacy.payments: For agreed work, Stripe hosts the payment page and processes payment details. We provide the customer contact, invoice description, amount and related billing information needed for that transaction. We receive invoice and payment status and limited payment-method information for reconciliation and support; our website does not collect full card numbers. Please do not send payment details through our inquiry form, email or chat.
privacy.paymentRetention: Client scopes, invoices and payment records are separate from unsuccessful inquiries. We retain the records needed to deliver the agreed work, keep accounts, meet applicable legal obligations and resolve disputes; the 90-day unsuccessful-inquiry period does not apply to these records. Stripe also retains information under its own policy and applicable requirements. You can contact us about access, correction or deletion, and we will explain any records we must retain.
privacy.analytics: We count page views and selected service, form, email-link and chat-open actions to understand how the website is used. A count contains the UTC day, a fixed event, service and page identifier, a total, and a broad source category for page views (such as Google, Bing, social, AI assistant, referral, campaign, internal or direct). The browser classifies the referring site or campaign parameter locally; it never sends the raw referrer, campaign value or full URL in the count. These are events, not unique people or linked visitor journeys. We do not attach names, emails, messages, visitor IDs or session IDs. Global Privacy Control, Do Not Track and the owner opt-out suppress collection. An explicit owner opt-out saves only that preference in local storage. Obvious bot signatures are filtered, but counts can still include automated traffic or omit blocked events. Separate keyed rate controls expire after 20 minutes and are cleared hourly. Aggregate totals are removed after 90 days; provider recovery copies can remain longer. Email and chat actions do not prove that a message was sent.
privacy.workbench: The optional lead-workbench demonstration uses fictional sample records. Changes remain in memory unless you choose to keep them in this browser. That choice writes unprotected local storage available to this website on this browser, until you reset the workbench or clear site data. No demo records are sent to the studio. Downloaded CSV files remain wherever you save them; reset does not remove those files. Do not put real customer information in the demo.

projectTiming: Typical website projects use 7–10 business days of production after the agreed start and ready content, access and business facts, plus the agreed client review windows. Larger scopes, extra features or delayed feedback can take longer; your written scope confirms the production, review and launch dates.
firstConversation: We start by email. Terry replies to the address you provide. If a call would help, we arrange one together; you do not need to book a call before sending your question or project details.
